resume-native.note: ZCode CLI does not separate desktop sessions from CLI sessions; desktop runs via Electron with CDP/internal socket, while CLI uses local sqlite session IDs. Testing native CLI resume succeeded.

observe-live.note: L0 CLI with --json outputs the entire JSON payload only once at process exit (no live chunks over stdout). TUI has visual streaming but cannot be piped programmatically.

observe-history.note: L0 CLI has no subcommand to read back session history (no `zcode history` or `zcode session read`). History must be accessed via sqlite db or app-server protocol.

state.note: L0 CLI is a short-lived one-shot process. There is no daemon status query command. State is only discernible via OS process lifecycle (running/exited).
state.evidence: CLI terminates immediately after turn ends.

cancel.note: L0 CLI can be interrupted via SIGINT/SIGTERM, terminating the process. However, cooperative in-flight turn cancellation without killing the process requires app-server.

close.note: L0 CLI has no session close subcommand.

steer.note: L0 CLI accepts stdin only at invocation; mid-turn steering is not supported via CLI.

permission.note: L0 CLI supports --mode (build, edit, plan, yolo, guarded). However, interactive permission prompting mid-turn requires TUI or app-server protocol; in -p mode it defaults to mode behavior.

fork.note: L0 CLI supports /fork slash command in interactive TUI, but lacks a non-interactive CLI flag like --fork <checkpoint>.
fork.evidence: zcode --help shows /fork under Slash Commands, but no CLI option.

compact.note: L0 CLI has /compact slash command in interactive TUI, but no CLI argument --compact.
compact.evidence: zcode --help shows /compact under Slash Commands only.

model-list.note: L0 CLI has no subcommand to list models (no `zcode models`). Models are only discoverable via TUI /model or app-server session/create response.

model-new.note: Model can be specified via ZCODE_MODEL environment variable before launching the session.

quota.note: L0 CLI has /quota slash command in TUI. In CLI mode, quota must be read from SQLite db ~/.zcode/cli/db/db.sqlite (model_usage table).
quota.evidence: model_usage table in db.sqlite tracks tokens & rate limits.
